clip.lead: Create a short-lived note in three steps. Text stays on cv.cm until 10 views or one day.
clip.s1b: You get a blank note. Nothing is listed publicly. Only people with the link can open it.
clip.s2b: Drop text, Markdown, an image, or a file. The counter shows how much of the 64 KB text budget you have used.
clip.s3b: Submit the note, copy the URL, and send it. The last view tells the reader the note is gone.

qr.lead: Turn a URL or line of text into a QR code in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
qr.s1b: A sample cv.cm URL is already filled in, and the preview draws at once.
qr.s2b: Paste your own URL or message. Error correction, foreground, and background colors sit in the left rail.
qr.s3b: When the square looks right, download a PNG. Closing the tab discards the data.

barcode.lead: Make a Code 128, Code 39, or EAN-13 barcode in this tab and download a PNG.
barcode.s1b: Code 128 is selected, with a short sample value already drawn.
barcode.s2b: Type the string or digits. Switch to Code 39 or EAN-13 if you need those formats (EAN-13 wants 12 or 13 digits).
barcode.s3b: The preview updates as you type. Download when the bars look correct.

watermark.lead: Stamp text on a photo or ID copy in this tab. Files never leave the browser.
watermark.s1b: Use the drop zone on the left. PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF work.
watermark.s2b: Drop a file or click the zone. A preview appears as soon as the browser can decode it.
watermark.s3b: For an ID copy, tile “for [org] use only”. For a shop photo, a name or logo is enough.
watermark.s4b: When the mark sits where you want, download one file or a ZIP of the batch. An invisible watermark is added by default; change its text or check a file under Invisible watermark.

collage.lead: Combine photos into one picture. Layouts and Instagram sizes stay in this tab.
collage.s1b: The left rail is the drop zone. Nothing is uploaded.
collage.s2b: Drop several files. They show up in the list so you can reorder or remove them.
collage.s3b: Choose a grid or split. Square, 4:5, 9:16, and 16:9 sizes are built in.
collage.s4b: Check the combined picture, then export PNG, JPEG, or WebP.

resize.lead: Resize or compress a photo to exact pixels or a max edge. The file stays in this tab.
resize.s1b: Drop a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or similar photo on the left.
resize.s2b: The preview shows the current pixels. Set width, height, or a maximum edge.
resize.s3b: Pick JPEG or WebP quality if you need a lighter file, then download.

crop.lead: Crop a photo in this tab. Free, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, and 9:16.
crop.s1b: Drop a photo on the left. Nothing is uploaded.
crop.s2b: A crop box appears on the preview. Drag it or switch to 1:1 and other ratios.
crop.s3b: When the frame is right, download JPEG, PNG, or WebP.

rotate.lead: Rotate or flip a photo in this tab. 90°, 180°, or any angle.
rotate.s1b: Drop a photo on the left. The preview is empty until a file is added.
rotate.s2b: The original orientation shows first. Use Left, Right, 180°, or the angle slider.
rotate.s3b: Flip horizontally or vertically if you need a mirror, then download.

exif.lead: Strip EXIF and GPS from a photo in this tab, then download a clean file.
exif.s1b: Drop a JPEG or other photo on the left. The file is not uploaded.
exif.s2b: The tool reports whether metadata was found. The preview is the picture only.
exif.s3b: Export JPEG, PNG, or WebP without the camera EXIF and GPS tags.

meme.lead: Put Impact-style captions on a photo in this tab and download a PNG.
meme.s1b: Drop a photo on the left. Nothing is uploaded.
meme.s2b: The picture fills the preview. Top and bottom caption fields sit in the right rail.
meme.s3b: Enter a top line and a bottom line. Outline text scales with the photo.
meme.s4b: Check the preview, then download a PNG.

signature.lead: Draw a signature in this tab and download a cropped transparent PNG. Not a legal e-sign.
signature.s1b: The pad is empty. Pick stroke color and thickness on the left if you want.
signature.s2b: Write with the mouse or a finger. Undo removes the last stroke; Clear wipes the pad.
signature.s3b: Export crops to the ink. This is a picture, not DocuSign and not a qualified e-signature.

favicon.lead: Make ICO and PNG favicons from a photo in this tab.
favicon.s1b: Drop a square-ish photo or logo on the left.
favicon.s2b: The preview shows how the icon is squared. Cover or contain changes the crop.
favicon.s3b: Export the pack when the square looks right. Nothing is uploaded.

convert.lead: Convert HEIC, WebP, PNG, JPEG, and related formats in this tab. Optional resize.
convert.s1b: Drop one file or a batch on the left. Shortcuts cover HEIC → JPG and WebP → PNG.
convert.s2b: Pick the output format and, if you want, a max edge so huge photos shrink.
convert.s3t: Download one file or a ZIP
convert.s3b: Download the current file, or the whole batch as a ZIP. Conversion stays in this tab.

image-pdf.lead: Turn JPG or PNG photos into one PDF in this tab. A4, Letter, or fit-to-photo.
image-pdf.s1b: Drop one photo or several. They become pages, in order.
image-pdf.s2b: Reorder the list if the page order is wrong. Choose A4, Letter, or a page that matches the photo.
image-pdf.s3b: Each image is fitted onto its page without cropping. The PDF is built here.

pdf-jpg.lead: Render PDF pages to JPG, PNG, or WebP in this tab. Download one page or a ZIP.
pdf-jpg.s1b: Drop a PDF on the left. The file is not uploaded.
pdf-jpg.s2b: Pages render in the preview. Pick JPG, PNG, or WebP.
pdf-jpg.s3b: Save one page or a ZIP of every page.

merge-pdf.lead: Combine several PDFs into one file in this tab. Reorder, then download.
merge-pdf.s1b: Drop two or more PDFs on the left.
merge-pdf.s2b: They appear in a list. Drag to change order if the first file should not be first.
merge-pdf.s3b: The new file is built in this tab. Closing the page discards the originals.

compress-pdf.lead: Shrink a PDF by re-encoding pages as JPEG. This stays in the browser.
compress-pdf.s1b: Drop a PDF on the left.
compress-pdf.s2b: Pages render so you can judge quality. Size after compress is shown when ready.
compress-pdf.s3b: Export when the preview is still readable. Vector text becomes a picture.

split-pdf.lead: Split a PDF into one file per page, or extract a range, in this tab.
split-pdf.s1b: Drop a PDF on the left.
split-pdf.s2b: Choose one file per page, or type a range such as 1–3,5.
split-pdf.s3b: Save a ZIP of pages or the extracted range. Nothing is uploaded.

invoice.lead: Fill issuer, customer, and line items, then download an A4 PDF. Not a tax invoice.
invoice.s1b: The form is on the left; the A4 preview is on the right. Nothing is uploaded.
invoice.s2b: Enter who you are, who you bill, currency, tax, and at least one line item.
invoice.s3b: Totals update as you type. CJK text is drawn into the page so it prints.
invoice.s4b: Export one A4 page. This is not accounting software and not a government tax form.

audio.lead: Decode MP3, M4A, OGG, and similar files to WAV in this tab.
audio.s1b: Drop an audio file on the left. It is not uploaded.
audio.s2b: The browser decodes it. Pick the original sample rate, 44.1 kHz, or 48 kHz.
audio.s3b: Play a preview if you want, then download. Closing the tab discards the file.

audio-cutter.lead: Trim a clip in this tab and download the range as WAV.
audio-cutter.s1b: Drop an MP3 or WAV on the left.
audio-cutter.s2b: A waveform and start/end controls appear after decode.
audio-cutter.s3b: Move start and end, listen if you want, then download the trimmed WAV.

audio-joiner.lead: Join several clips into one WAV in this tab.
audio-joiner.s1b: Drop two or more audio files on the left.
audio-joiner.s2b: They list in order. Reorder if the first file should not play first.
audio-joiner.s3b: Export one file. Decode and join stay in this tab.

data.lead: Pretty-print JSON, convert CSV, Base64, URL encoding, and Markdown in this tab.
data.s1b: JSON pretty-print is the default mode. Paste on the left.
data.s2b: The right pane formats as you type. Switch mode for CSV, Base64, or Markdown.
data.s3b: Copy the result, or download a file. You can also open a .json / .csv / .md from disk.

xml-json.lead: Convert XML to JSON or JSON to XML in this tab.
xml-json.s1b: A small XML sample is already converted so you can see the shape.
xml-json.s2b: The right pane is the conversion. Paste your own XML on the left to replace the sample.
xml-json.s3t: Switch direction if you need JSON → XML
xml-json.s3b: Use the mode menu, then copy the output. Nothing is uploaded.

password.lead: Generate a strong password on this device. Length and character sets are yours to pick.
password.s1b: A 16-character password is already generated with letters, digits, and symbols.
password.s2b: Move the slider. Tick lower case, upper case, digits, symbols, and whether to skip 0/O/1/l.
password.s3b: Click Generate for a new string, then Copy. Store it in your own password manager.

word-count.lead: Count words, characters, sentences, and reading time in this tab.
word-count.s1b: The stats rail starts at zero. Paste on the right, or open a .txt / .md file.
word-count.s2b: Counts update as you type. CJK characters count as words.
word-count.s3b: Use words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, lines, and reading time. Nothing is uploaded.

color.lead: Pick a color, copy hex / RGB / HSL, and check contrast. Eyedropper when the browser allows.
color.s1b: A sample pink is loaded. Hex, RGB, and HSL fields sit together.
color.s2b: Type a hex value, use the native color input, or the eyedropper when your browser has one.
color.s3b: The swatch and contrast note update live. Copy the format you need.

hex-rgb.lead: Paste a hex color and read RGB, HSL, and CMYK in this tab.
hex-rgb.s1b: A sample hex is already converted.
hex-rgb.s2b: Type #rrggbb or a CSS color. The swatch and values update at once.
hex-rgb.s3b: Copy rgb() or the other formats. Nothing is uploaded.

names.lead: Generate person names or usernames in this tab and copy the list.
names.s1b: A list of person names is already filled in.
names.s2t: Switch to usernames if you need handles
names.s2b: Use the kind menu and the count slider. Generate refreshes the list.
names.s3b: Copy all names at once. They are random strings, not a registry of real people.

timezone.lead: Convert a clock time between IANA zones, including daylight saving.
timezone.s1b: From is your guessed local zone; to starts at UTC.
timezone.s2b: Set from, to, and the datetime. Use Now if you want the current instant.
timezone.s3b: The result and ISO string update at once. Copy when you need to paste it elsewhere.

timestamp.lead: Convert Unix time to a date, or a date to Unix time, in this tab.
timestamp.s1b: The current Unix time is filled in so you can see every format.
timestamp.s2b: Seconds, milliseconds, and ISO-8601 all parse. Use Now to reset to this instant.
timestamp.s3b: Read UTC, local, and Unix fields, then copy one of them.

lorem.lead: Generate lorem ipsum paragraphs, sentences, or words in this tab.
lorem.s2b: Switch to sentences or words, then move the count slider.
lorem.s3b: Copy the block into a layout. Nothing is uploaded.

units.lead: Convert length, mass, temperature, volume, area, and speed in this tab.
units.s1b: Length starts at inches → centimetres with 1 in filled in.
units.s2b: Type the amount. Change kind, from, and to if you need kg, °C, or another pair.
units.s3b: The converted value and a short formula show on the right. Swap flips the pair.

text-to-speech.lead: Hear text with your device voices. Rate and pitch stay in this tab. No MP3 file is uploaded.
text-to-speech.s1b: A sample sentence is already in the box. Voices come from the browser.
text-to-speech.s2b: Replace the sample. Pick a voice, then set rate and pitch if you want.
text-to-speech.s3b: Press Speak. Pause and Stop control playback. This is not a file export.

diff.lead: Compare two texts line by line in this tab. Added and removed lines are marked.
diff.s1b: Left is the original; right is the revision. Both start empty.
diff.s2b: The unified diff draws under the panes. Tick ignore extra whitespace if spacing is noise.
diff.s3b: Copy the unified diff when you need to paste it into a review.

uuid.lead: Generate RFC 4122 version 4 UUIDs in this tab. v1 is not offered.
uuid.s1b: A short list of v4 UUIDs is already generated.
uuid.s2b: Move the count slider. Hyphens and uppercase are optional.
uuid.s3b: Generate again if you need a fresh batch, then copy. Values come from crypto.getRandomValues.

hash.lead: Hash text or a file in this tab. MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512.
hash.s1b: SHA-256 is the default. Paste on the right or open a file.
hash.s2b: Hex and Base64 digests appear as you type. Switch algorithm from the menu.
hash.s3b: Copy hex (or Base64). Hashing a file never uploads it.

regex.lead: Test a regular expression in this tab. See matches and a replace preview.
regex.s1b: Pattern, flags, and a replace field sit on the left. The sample text is on the right.
regex.s2b: Type the expression. g is on by default; add i, m, s, or u if you need them.
regex.s3b: Matches highlight in the text. A list of captures sits under the preview.
regex.s4b: Fill the replace field to preview substitutions, then copy a match if you need it.

yaml-json.lead: Convert YAML to JSON or JSON to YAML in this tab. Simple maps and lists are enough for most configs.
yaml-json.s1b: A short sample document is already converted. The direction menu sits on the left.
yaml-json.s2b: Switch YAML → JSON or JSON → YAML. Nested maps and lists indent as usual.
yaml-json.s3b: Copy when the output looks right. Closing the tab discards both sides.

case.lead: Change letter case in this tab: upper, lower, title, camel, snake, and more.
case.s1b: A sample sentence is already converted to Title Case.
case.s2b: Pick a case from the menu. camelCase and snake_case split on spaces and punctuation.
case.s3b: Copy the converted text. Nothing is uploaded.

jwt.lead: Read a JWT header and payload in this tab. The signature is never verified.
jwt.s1b: The token field is empty. Header and payload panes wait on the right.
jwt.s2b: A JWT has two or three parts separated by dots. Header and payload appear as JSON.
jwt.s3b: Copy the payload if you need it. This is not proof the token is authentic.

screenshot.lead: Mark up a screenshot in this tab. Draw a box or arrow, add a label, download a PNG.
screenshot.s1b: The drop zone is on the left. PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF work.
screenshot.s2b: Drop or paste a photo. Pick Box, Arrow, or Text, then drag on the preview.
screenshot.s3b: Undo if a mark is wrong, then download. Closing the tab discards the file.

percent.lead: Work out percentages in this tab: a percent of a number, or what percent one number is of another.
percent.s1b: A and B start with sample values. Four results appear on the right.
percent.s2b: A% of B, A as a percent of B, B plus A%, and the change from B to A all update as you type.
percent.s3b: Copy puts all four lines on the clipboard. Nothing is uploaded.

random.lead: Generate random integers in this tab with Web Crypto. Min and max are inclusive.
random.s1b: The default range is 1 to 100. One number is already rolled.
random.s2b: Change min, max, and how many numbers you want, then roll.
random.s3b: Copy puts one integer per line. Values come from crypto.getRandomValues.

html.lead: Encode or decode HTML entities in this tab. The text never leaves the browser.
html.s1b: A sample tag is already encoded. Encode and Decode sit in the left menu.
html.s2b: Encode turns <>&"' into entities. Decode reverses named codes and &#…; numbers.
html.s3b: Copy when it looks right. Closing the tab discards both sides.

cron.lead: Read a five-field cron expression in this tab. It does not run jobs.
cron.s1b: A weekday office-hours sample is already explained on the right.
cron.s2b: Use minute hour day-of-month month weekday. Stars, lists, ranges, and */n work.
cron.s3b: Copy the English summary. This is not a scheduler.

slug.lead: Turn a title into a URL slug in this tab: lowercase, hyphens, no punctuation.
slug.s1b: A sample title is already turned into a slug.
slug.s2b: Accents fold, other characters become hyphens, and the slug is capped at 80 characters.
slug.s3b: Copy when it looks right. Nothing is uploaded.

portrait-sim.lead: Practice a portrait sitting in this tab. Swap the sitter and scene, then set the camera and export.
portrait-sim.s1b: The viewfinder shows a photoreal adult at a window. Nothing is uploaded.
portrait-sim.s2b: Use the left rail. Window, open shade, cafe and indoor are empty stages.
portrait-sim.s3t: Set a wide lens close in
portrait-sim.s3b: Choose 24 mm and move closer than 1.5 m to see the wide-and-close hint. Facial proportions stay as posed; a real camera would also change them.
portrait-sim.s4b: Export JPEG or PNG. The AF box stays off the file. Closing the tab discards the sitting.

age.lead: Find age in years, months, and days in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
age.s1b: Birth date and “on this date” sit on the left. Results appear on the right.
age.s2b: Change the birth date or the other date. Years, months, days, and total days update.
age.s3b: Copy puts a one-line summary on the clipboard.

bmi.lead: Work out adult BMI from kilograms and centimetres. This is not medical advice.
bmi.s1b: Sample weight and height are already filled. BMI and a WHO band sit on the right.
bmi.s2b: The index updates as you type. Bands are under 18.5, 18.5–24.9, 25–29.9, and 30+.
bmi.s3b: Copy puts the number and band on the clipboard. Nothing is uploaded.

binary.lead: Convert text to UTF-8 binary, or binary back to text, in this tab.
binary.s1b: A sample word is already turned into 8-bit groups.
binary.s2b: Switch Text → binary or Binary → text. Spaces in binary are ignored when decoding.
binary.s3b: Copy when it looks right. Closing the tab discards both sides.

tip.lead: Work out a tip and split a bill in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
tip.s1b: Sample bill, percent, and people are already filled. Tip, total, and share sit on the right.
tip.s2b: The tip is bill × percent. Each person pays the total divided by the people count.
tip.s3b: Copy puts tip, total, and per person on the clipboard.

morse.lead: Convert Latin text to International Morse, or Morse back to text, in this tab.
morse.s1b: A sample word is already converted. Direction sits on the left.
morse.s2b: Letters are spaced. Words use a slash. Unknown Morse shows an error.
morse.s3b: Copy when it looks right. Closing the tab discards both sides.

roman.lead: Convert 1–3999 to standard Roman numerals, or valid Roman back to a number.
roman.s1b: A sample year is already converted. Direction sits on the left.
roman.s2t: Enter a number or a numeral
roman.s2b: IV is 4. Additive IIII is rejected. The range stops at 3999.
roman.s3b: Copy puts the converted value on the clipboard. Nothing is uploaded.

discount.lead: Find the sale price after a percent off in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
discount.s1b: A sample price and percent are already filled. Sale price and savings sit on the right.
discount.s2b: Sale price is original minus original × percent. Savings is the amount off.
discount.s3b: Copy puts sale price and savings on the clipboard.

countdown.lead: Run a countdown in this tab. Closing the tab stops it. It is not a system alarm.
countdown.s1b: Hours, minutes, and seconds sit on the left. The remaining time is on the right.
countdown.s2b: Start, pause, or reset. The count only runs while this tab stays open.
countdown.s3b: At 00:00:00 the timer stops. Reset to load the fields again.

loan.lead: Estimate a fixed monthly payment from principal, yearly rate, and years. Not a bank quote.
loan.s1b: A sample 30-year loan is already filled. Monthly payment sits on the right.
loan.s2b: Months are years × 12. The rate is yearly percent divided by 12.
loan.s3b: Copy puts monthly payment, total interest, and total paid on the clipboard.

stopwatch.lead: Time elapsed seconds in this tab. Closing the tab stops it. It is not a system clock.
stopwatch.s1b: Elapsed time starts at 00:00:00.00 on the right. Start and reset sit on the left.
stopwatch.s2b: Start, pause, or reset. The count only runs while this tab stays open.
stopwatch.s3b: The display is hours, minutes, seconds, and hundredths. Reset returns to zero.

compound.lead: Estimate a future value from principal, yearly rate, years, and compounding. Not investment advice.
compound.s1b: A sample 10-year amount is already filled. Future value sits on the right.
compound.s2t: Change principal, rate, years, or frequency
compound.s2b: A = P (1 + r/n)^(n t). Monthly compounds 12 times a year.
compound.s3b: Copy puts future value and interest on the clipboard.

vat.lead: Add VAT or split a gross price into net and tax in this tab. Not a tax filing.
vat.s1b: A sample amount and 20% rate are already filled. Net, tax, and gross sit on the right.
vat.s2b: Exclusive adds tax on top. Inclusive works backwards from a gross price.
vat.s3b: Copy puts net, tax, and gross on the clipboard.

reverse.lead: Reverse a line of text in this tab and see if it is a palindrome. Nothing is uploaded.
reverse.s1b: A sample line is already filled. The reversed string sits on the right.
reverse.s2b: The reverse updates as you type. Palindrome ignores spaces, punctuation, and case.
reverse.s3b: Copy puts the reversed text on the clipboard.

url-encode.lead: Percent-encode or decode a string in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
url-encode.s1b: A sample query is already encoded on the right. Encode is selected.
url-encode.s2b: Encode uses encodeURIComponent. Switch to Decode to turn % sequences back.
url-encode.s3b: Copy puts the encoded or decoded string on the clipboard.

text-hex.lead: Turn text into UTF-8 hex, or hex back into text, in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
text-hex.s1b: A sample string is already converted to spaced hex on the right.
text-hex.s2b: Switch to Hex → text to decode. Spaces in the hex are fine.
text-hex.s3b: Copy puts the hex or the decoded text on the clipboard.

json.lead: Pretty-print or minify JSON in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
json.s1b: A sample object is already pretty-printed on the right.
json.s2b: Switch to Minify for one line. Invalid JSON shows an error.
json.s3b: Copy puts the formatted JSON on the clipboard.

base64.lead: Encode text as Base64 or decode it back in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
base64.s1b: A sample string is already encoded on the right.
base64.s2b: Switch to Decode to turn Base64 back into text. UTF-8 is used.
base64.s3b: Copy puts the encoded or decoded string on the clipboard.

days.lead: Count calendar days between two dates in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
days.s1b: A sample start date and today are already filled. The day count sits on the right.
days.s2b: The signed count can be negative if the end date is earlier. Leap days are included.
days.s3b: Copy puts signed days, absolute days, and whole weeks on the clipboard.

sort.lead: Sort lines or drop duplicates in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
sort.s1b: A sample list is already sorted A→Z on the right.
sort.s2b: Switch to Z→A or Unique. Unique keeps the first copy of each line.
sort.s3b: Copy puts the result on the clipboard.

replace.lead: Find literal text and replace it in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
replace.s1b: A sample line and find string are already filled.
replace.s2b: Replace all is the default. Switch to Replace first for one match. This is not regex.
replace.s3b: Copy puts the replaced text on the clipboard.

words.lead: Turn a whole number into US English words in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
words.s1b: 2026 is already filled as two thousand twenty-six.
words.s3b: Copy puts the English words on the clipboard.

add-days.lead: Add or subtract whole days from a calendar date in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
add-days.s1t: Open Add days to a date
add-days.s1b: Today and +30 days are already filled. The new date sits on the right.
add-days.s2t: Change the date or the day count
add-days.s2b: Negative days go backwards. Leap days are included.
add-days.s3b: Copy puts YYYY-MM-DD on the clipboard.

week.lead: Find the ISO week number for a date in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
week.s1b: Today is already filled. ISO week, year, and weekday sit on the right.
week.s2b: Week 1 contains the first Thursday of the year. Monday is weekday 1.
week.s3b: Copy puts the ISO week label on the clipboard.

aspect.lead: Simplify a width and height to a ratio such as 16:9 in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
aspect.s2b: The numbers are rounded to pixels, then reduced by their greatest common divisor.
aspect.s3b: Copy puts 16:9 (or your ratio) on the clipboard.

workdays.lead: Count Monday–Friday days between two dates in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
workdays.s1b: A Monday and the Friday of that week are already filled. The count sits on the right.
workdays.s2b: Both dates count when they are weekdays. Saturdays and Sundays are skipped. Holidays are not.
workdays.s3b: Copy puts the business-day count and weekend days on the clipboard.

fraction.lead: Simplify a fraction or turn a decimal into a fraction in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
fraction.s2b: Choose From decimal and try 0.75. It becomes 3/4, up to a denominator of 10,000.
fraction.s3b: Copy puts the simplified fraction on the clipboard.

hourly.lead: Turn an hourly wage into yearly gross pay, or the reverse, in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
hourly.s1b: 20 per hour, 40 hours a week, and 52 weeks are already filled.
hourly.s2t: Change the hours or start from yearly pay
hourly.s2b: Switch the mode to start from a yearly amount. This is gross pay only, with no tax.
hourly.s3b: Copy puts hourly, weekly, and yearly gross pay on the clipboard.

margin.lead: Turn a cost and a selling price into profit, margin, and markup in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
margin.s1b: Cost 50 and price 80 are already filled. Profit, margin, and markup sit on the right.
margin.s2t: Change the cost or the price
margin.s2b: Margin is profit divided by price. Markup is profit divided by cost.
margin.s3b: Copy puts profit, margin, and markup on the clipboard.

radix.lead: Convert an integer between bases 2 and 36 in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
radix.s1b: 255 from base 10 to base 16 is already shown as FF.
radix.s2t: Change the number or the bases
radix.s2b: Bases run from 2 to 36. Digits must fit the source base. Letters come out uppercase.
radix.s3b: Copy puts the converted integer on the clipboard.

duration.lead: Add or subtract two lengths of time in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
duration.s1b: 1:30:00 plus 0:45:00 is already filled. The sum is 2:15:00.
duration.s2b: Subtract takes the second duration off the first. A longer second time gives a negative result.
duration.s3b: Copy puts the H:MM:SS result and the total seconds on the clipboard.

tdee.lead: Estimate how many calories you burn a day from age, height, weight and activity. This is not medical advice.
tdee.s1t: Choose units and enter your details
tdee.s1b: Pick metric or imperial, then sex, age, weight and height. Switching units converts the numbers you already typed.
tdee.s2b: Be honest: most office workers who train a few times a week are light or moderate. BMR and TDEE update as you change it.
tdee.s3b: TDEE keeps weight steady; −500 kcal loses about 0.5 kg a week, +300 kcal gains slowly. Copy puts all four numbers on the clipboard.

cidr.lead: Work out an IPv4 subnet from CIDR notation, or turn an address range into CIDR blocks.
cidr.s1t: Type an address with a prefix
cidr.s1b: Enter 192.168.1.10/24, or an address and a netmask separated by a space. The block is normalised to its network address.
cidr.s2b: Network, broadcast, mask, wildcard, first and last host, total and usable host counts appear as you type.
cidr.s3b: Enter the first and last address on the right to get the smallest list of CIDR blocks that covers exactly that range, ready to copy.

chmod.lead: Turn Unix permissions between checkboxes, octal digits and the rwx string, and get the chmod command.
chmod.s1b: Each row is owner, group or others; each column is read, write or execute. Add setuid, setgid or sticky if you need them.
chmod.s2b: Type 644 or 4755, or paste rwxr-xr-x from ls -l. The other fields follow.
chmod.s3b: Enter a file or folder name, tick -R for a whole folder, then copy the chmod line and run it in your terminal.

typing.lead: Measure your typing speed and accuracy in 30 or 60 seconds. Results stay in the page.
typing.s1t: Choose a time and a passage
typing.s1b: Pick 30 or 60 seconds and one of the sample passages in your language.
typing.s2b: Click the box and start typing; the timer starts with the first key. Correct characters turn dark, mistakes turn pink.
typing.s3b: When time runs out or the passage is done you see speed (net WPM, or characters per minute for CJK) and accuracy. Restart to try again.

image-colors.lead: Pull a color palette out of any picture and copy the HEX codes, without uploading it.
image-colors.s1b: Drop a photo or screenshot on the left, click to choose one, or paste it.
image-colors.s2b: Slide from 2 to 12. The palette is recalculated straight away and sorted from the most common color.
image-colors.s3b: Click a swatch to copy its HEX code, or Copy all HEX for the whole palette.

gold.lead: Convert a gold weight in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
gold.s1b: 1 troy ounce is filled in. Grams and taels appear beside it.
gold.s2b: Switch among grams, troy ounces, and the three named taels.
gold.s3t: Add a price only if you have one
gold.s3b: Leave the dollar box empty to keep the page as a weight conversion.

silver.lead: Convert a silver weight in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
silver.s1b: 1 troy ounce is filled in. Grams and taels appear beside it.
silver.s2b: Switch among grams, troy ounces, and the three named taels.
silver.s3t: Add a price only if you have one
silver.s3b: Leave the dollar box empty to keep the page as a weight conversion.

platinum.lead: Convert a platinum weight in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
platinum.s1b: 1 troy ounce is filled in. Grams and taels appear beside it.
platinum.s2b: Switch among grams, troy ounces, and the three named taels.
platinum.s3t: Add a price only if you have one
platinum.s3b: Leave the dollar box empty to keep the page as a weight conversion.

palladium.lead: Convert a palladium weight in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
palladium.s1b: 1 troy ounce is filled in. Grams and taels appear beside it.
palladium.s2b: Switch among grams, troy ounces, and the three named taels.
palladium.s3t: Add a price only if you have one
palladium.s3b: Leave the dollar box empty to keep the page as a weight conversion.

oil.lead: Convert a petroleum barrel, a US gallon, and a liter in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
oil.s1b: 1 barrel is filled in. The other units update beside it.
oil.s2b: Choose barrel, US gallon, or liter. The same volume stays selected.
oil.s3b: Copy puts all three units on the clipboard. There is no price.

stocks.lead: Type the price and the share count. Nothing is uploaded, and no quote is fetched.
stocks.s1b: The price, share count, earnings, and dividend boxes start empty.
stocks.s2b: Use the company's share count. Market cap is price times that count.
stocks.s3t: Read a blank as no result
stocks.s3b: P/E is blank when earnings are zero. Yield is blank when the price is zero.

mosaic.lead: Pixelate or black out parts of a photo on this page. Files never leave the browser.
mosaic.s1b: Drop, click, or paste. Or press Try a sample ID first.
mosaic.s2t: Drag a box over what to hide
mosaic.s2b: Black box for ID numbers, mosaic for faces. Undo removes the last box.
mosaic.s3b: Download one image or a ZIP. Export drops EXIF.

dice.lead: Roll dice or flip coins in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
dice.s1b: Two six-sided dice are set. Change the count or pick d4 to d100.
dice.s2b: Each face, the total, and the highest and lowest die appear on the right.
dice.s3b: Set a number of coins and press Flip to see heads and tails. Copy puts the result on the clipboard.

gpa.lead: Turn letter grades and credits into a 4.0-scale GPA in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
gpa.s1b: Four sample courses are filled. The GPA, credits, and quality points sit on the right.
gpa.s2b: Pick a grade and credits per row. Add course adds a row; × removes one. Tick A+ = 4.3 if your school uses it.
gpa.s3b: Copy puts the GPA, total credits, and quality points on the clipboard.

pomodoro.lead: Run focus sessions and breaks with a chime in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
pomodoro.s1b: 25-minute focus, 5-minute short break, 15-minute long break, and 4 rounds are set.
pomodoro.s2b: The clock counts down and the tab title shows the time left. Pause stops it; Skip jumps to the next phase.
pomodoro.s3b: Edit the minutes or rounds while the clock is stopped and the current phase takes them right away. Reset starts over from round 1.

sleep.lead: Find a bedtime that ends on a full sleep cycle, or the best times to wake up. Nothing is uploaded.
sleep.s1b: Wake-up time is selected and 07:00 is filled. Four bedtimes for 6 to 3 cycles sit on the right.
sleep.s2b: Change the time to your alarm. Five or six cycles are the usual target; the shorter options are for short nights.
sleep.s3b: Switch to Bedtime and enter when you lie down to see wake-up times. Copy puts the list on the clipboard.

body-fat.lead: Estimate body fat from a tape measure with the U.S. Navy formula. Nothing is uploaded.
body-fat.s1b: Metric and male are selected with sample numbers. Body fat and category sit on the right.
body-fat.s2b: Height, neck and waist; women also enter hips. Switch to imperial for inches and pounds. Add weight to see fat and lean mass.
body-fat.s3b: The percentage and ACE category update as you type. Copy puts them on the clipboard.

contrast.lead: Check a text and background pair against WCAG 2 AA and AAA. Nothing is uploaded.
contrast.s1b: A sample pink on cream pair is filled. The ratio and pass/fail rows sit on the right under a text sample.
contrast.s2b: Type a hex code or use the color picker for text and background. Swap exchanges the two.
contrast.s3b: When normal text fails AA, the closest passing text color is suggested below the table. Copy puts the ratio and results on the clipboard.

pace.lead: Turn distance and time into pace, or pace into finish time, with race predictions. Nothing is uploaded.
pace.s1b: Pace is selected with 10 km in 55:00. The pace per km and per mile, speed, and race times sit on the right.
pace.s2b: Pick Pace, Time or Distance and fill the other two. Switch km to miles when needed.
pace.s3b: 5K, 10K, half and marathon times at the same pace update as you type. Copy puts the result on the clipboard.

grade.lead: See the score you need on the final to reach a grade. Nothing is uploaded.
grade.s1b: 85% current, 90% wanted and a 30% final are filled. The needed score sits on the right.
grade.s2b: Type your current grade, the grade you want and the final's weight from your syllabus.
grade.s3b: The table shows the final score needed for an A, B, C or D. Copy puts everything on the clipboard.

due-date.lead: Estimate the due date, the week of pregnancy and the trimester dates. Nothing is uploaded.
due-date.s1b: Last period is selected with a sample date 10 weeks ago and a 28-day cycle. The due date and today's week sit on the right.
due-date.s2b: Type the first day of the last period. If your cycle is not 28 days, change the length; a 32-day cycle moves the due date 4 days later.
due-date.s3t: Or start from conception or a known due date
due-date.s3b: Switch I know my to Conception date or Due date and enter it. Weeks, trimesters and the other dates follow. Copy puts them on the clipboard.

ideal-weight.lead: See the ideal weight for your height by four formulas and the healthy BMI range. Nothing is uploaded.
ideal-weight.s1b: Metric, male and 170 cm are set. The four formula results and the BMI range sit on the right.
ideal-weight.s2b: Pick Male or Female and type the height. Switch to imperial for feet and inches; the results then show in pounds.
ideal-weight.s3t: Read the range, not one number
ideal-weight.s3b: The formulas differ by a few kilograms; the BMI row shows the healthy band. Copy puts all five lines on the clipboard.

water-intake.lead: Estimate how much water to drink a day from weight, exercise and climate. Nothing is uploaded.
water-intake.s1b: 70 kg, 30 minutes of exercise and a temperate climate are set. The total in litres and glasses sits on the right.
water-intake.s2b: Type the weight in kg or switch to lb. Enter the minutes of exercise on a typical day.
water-intake.s3b: Pick Hot or humid to add half a litre. The breakdown shows how much comes from weight, exercise and climate. Copy puts it on the clipboard.

fuel-cost.lead: Work out the fuel and cost of a trip, round trip and per person. Nothing is uploaded.
fuel-cost.s1b: 300 km at 7 L/100 km and 1.60 per litre are set. The cost, litres and cost per 100 km sit on the right.
fuel-cost.s2b: Type the trip distance in km or miles, your car's economy in L/100 km, km/L or mpg, and the pump price per litre or gallon.
fuel-cost.s3b: Tick Round trip to double the distance and set the number of people to split the cost. Copy puts the result on the clipboard.

reading-time.lead: See how long a text takes to read silently or aloud. Nothing is uploaded.
reading-time.s1b: A sample paragraph is filled at average speed. Reading time, speaking time and the counts sit on the right.
reading-time.s2b: Clear the sample and paste an article, essay or speech. Chinese, Japanese and Korean are counted in characters.
reading-time.s3b: Choose Slow for technical text or Fast for light reading. Speaking time stays at 130 words a minute. Copy puts the numbers on the clipboard.

time-card.lead: Total a week of shifts, breaks and overtime. Nothing is uploaded.
time-card.s1b: Five shifts from 09:00 to 17:30 with a 30-minute break are filled: 40 hours. Each row shows its hours on the right.
time-card.s2b: Change the start, end and break minutes per row. Add shift adds a row; × removes one. An end before the start runs past midnight.
time-card.s3b: Type the hourly rate to see gross pay. Hours above the overtime threshold are paid at the multiplier. Copy puts the totals on the clipboard.

electricity.lead: Work out what an appliance costs to run. Nothing is uploaded.
electricity.s1b: A 1000 W air conditioner for 8 hours a day, 30 days, at 0.15 per kWh is filled. The cost sits on the right.
electricity.s2t: Pick an appliance or type watts
electricity.s2b: Choose a preset or type the watts from the label. Set the hours a day, the days and how many of them run.
electricity.s3b: Type the price per kWh from your bill. The cost for the period, per day and per year update. Copy puts them on the clipboard.

ovulation.lead: See the fertile window, likely ovulation and next period for three cycles. Nothing is uploaded.
ovulation.s1b: A sample last period 10 days ago and a 28-day cycle are filled. Three cycles sit on the right.
ovulation.s2b: Type the first day of your last period. The dates are in this tab only.
ovulation.s3b: Type the average length of your cycle, 21 to 45 days. The dates move with it. Copy puts them on the clipboard.

macro.lead: Turn a calorie target into grams of protein, fat and carbs. Nothing is uploaded.
macro.s1b: 2500 kcal, maintain and a balanced split are set. The grams sit on the right.
macro.s2b: Type your maintenance calories (the TDEE calculator estimates them) and pick lose, maintain or gain.
macro.s3b: Pick balanced, low carb or high protein. Add your weight to see protein per kg. Copy puts the grams on the clipboard.

calories-burned.lead: Estimate calories burned for an activity and compare it with others. Nothing is uploaded.
calories-burned.s1b: Brisk walking, 70 kg and 30 minutes are set. Calories and a list of other activities sit on the right.
calories-burned.s2b: Type your weight in kg or switch to lb, and the minutes of activity.
calories-burned.s3b: Choose from 16 activities. The comparison list shows the same time for every activity. Copy puts the result on the clipboard.

remove-background.lead: Cut people, products or pets out of a photo in this tab, then download a transparent PNG.
remove-background.s1b: Drop or paste one or more pictures. The first run downloads the AI model once.
remove-background.s2b: Keep it transparent, or fill white, a color or a blurred copy. Hold the compare button to check edges.
remove-background.s3b: Save PNG or WebP with transparency, JPG on white, or every photo as a ZIP.

image-upscaler.lead: Enlarge a small or blurry picture 2× or 4× with AI, then download the sharp copy.
image-upscaler.s1b: Drop or paste a picture. Upscaling starts at once on your GPU or CPU.
image-upscaler.s2b: Pick 2× or 4×, and Photo or Anime / art, then upscale again. Drag the slider to compare.
image-upscaler.s3b: Save the result as PNG, JPG or WebP.

speech-to-text.lead: Turn a recording or video into text and subtitles in this tab.
speech-to-text.s1b: Drop an audio or video file, or record from the microphone.
speech-to-text.s2b: Leave the language on automatic or pick it, and choose Fast or Accurate. Text appears as it is written.
speech-to-text.s3b: Copy the text, or download TXT, SRT or VTT subtitles with timestamps.

depth-map.lead: Make a depth map from one photo in this tab.
depth-map.s1b: Drop or paste a picture. The model downloads once, then runs in seconds.
depth-map.s2b: Grayscale for 3D tools, or Turbo and Magma colors to read depth at a glance. Invert if your tool expects near = dark.
depth-map.s3b: Save a PNG the same size as your photo.

wheel.lead: Pick a name or option at random with a spinning wheel. Nothing is uploaded.
wheel.s1b: Six sample food choices are on the wheel. The list sits on the left, one entry per line.
wheel.s2b: Replace the list with your names or options, one per line. Shuffle and Sort reorder the slices.
wheel.s3b: The wheel slows to a stop and shows the winner, which is added to History. Tick “Remove the winner after each spin” to draw without repeats.

average.lead: Get the mean, median, mode and standard deviation of a list of numbers. Nothing is uploaded.
average.s1b: Seven sample numbers are filled in. The results sit on the right.
average.s2b: Type or paste numbers separated by spaces, new lines or semicolons, and pick the decimal mark you use. Anything that is not a number is listed as skipped.
average.s3b: Mean, median, mode, sum, range, standard deviation and variance update as you type. Copy puts them all on the clipboard.

metronome.lead: Keep time with an online metronome. Nothing is uploaded.
metronome.s1b: It starts at 120 BPM in 4 beats per bar. Press Start to hear it; the dots follow each beat.
metronome.s2b: Type a BPM, drag the slider or use −5, −1, +1 and +5. Or press Tap in time with a song.
metronome.s3b: Pick beats per bar (3 for a waltz) and clicks per beat for eighths, triplets or sixteenths. The first beat is accented.

keyboard-test.lead: Check that every key on your keyboard works. Nothing is uploaded.
keyboard-test.s1b: A full keyboard map appears. Click it so it can read your key presses.
keyboard-test.s2b: Each working key turns pink, and the last key shows its key, code and keyCode on the left.
keyboard-test.s3b: The counter shows how many keys you have tested and the most held at once. Reset starts over.

zodiac.lead: Find the star sign and Chinese zodiac animal for a birthday. Nothing is uploaded.
zodiac.s1b: A sample birthday, 15 August 1995, shows Leo and the wood Pig.
zodiac.s2b: Pick the date of birth. The star sign, element, Chinese zodiac animal, year element and year name update.
zodiac.s3b: For January and February birthdays the tool compares the date with Lunar New Year and says when the animal is the previous year’s.
